title: 3 arrested in P408K Oriental Mindoro drug bust
summary: Three drug suspects were arrested after authorities seized around 60 grams of suspected shabu worth P408,000 in a buy-bust operation in Sitio Rosal, Barangay Agos in Oriental Mindoro.
